description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 05.12.2016 to 11.12.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs valuation and financial compliance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory requirements for customs operations.
